_comment: This is NOT an ETSI-defined file format. It is an illustrative instance of the ETSI GS NFV-IFA 011 V5.4.1 Vnfd information element (clause 7.1.2) as it would exist inside an NFVO/VNFM AFTER PARSING the TOSCA package ExampleCorp_HybridWebCnf_vnf_pkg. Attribute names follow IFA011 exactly ([ETSI SEMANTIC] / [MANO INTERPRETATION]); values are the concrete parse result of the TOSCA node templates in Definitions/ExampleCorp_HybridWebCnf_df_simple.yaml ([TOSCA REPRESENTATION] -> [MANO INTERPRETATION] mapping). See ETSI_VNFD_Helm_Support_and_Parsing.md section 4 for the element-by-element derivation and clause citations.
_comment_vdu: IFA011 cl. 7.1.6.2 Vdu information element. Parsed from the WebVdu node template (tosca.nodes.nfv.Vdu.OsContainerDeployableUnit, SOL001 cl. 6.8.13).

vdu.name: web-vdu
vdu.description: Web frontend deployable unit for HybridWebCnf
vdu._comment: virtualComputeDesc is absent (null) because this VDU is realized by OS containers, not a VM - IFA011 cl. 7.1.6.2.2 Note 10.

_comment_osContainerDesc: IFA011 cl. 7.1.6.13 OsContainerDesc information element. Parsed from the WebContainer node template (tosca.nodes.nfv.Vdu.OsContainer, SOL001 cl. 6.8.12), reached via WebVdu's 'container' requirement (SOL001 Table 6.8.13.4-1).

osContainerDesc.name: web-container
osContainerDesc.description: Web frontend OS container (nginx-based application server)

_comment_swImageDesc: IFA011 cl. 7.1.6.5 SwImageDesc information element. Parsed from the 'sw_image' artifact (tosca.artifacts.nfv.SwImage, SOL001 cl. 6.3.1) on the WebContainer node template.
_comment_df: IFA011 cl. 7.1.8.2 VnfDf information element - one entry per TOSCA deployment flavour (here, the single 'simple' flavour).

df.description: Containerized web VNF combining an explicit OsContainer resource description with Helm-based (MCIOP) deployment
df._comment_vduProfile: IFA011 cl. 7.1.8.3 VduProfile, parsed from WebVdu.vdu_profile.
df._comment_mciopProfile: IFA011 cl. 7.1.8.20 MciopProfile. VnfDf cl. 7.1.8.2.2: 'This attribute shall be present if the DF references (via the vduProfile) containerized workloads based on a MCIOP.' Parsed from the web_mciop node template (tosca.nodes.nfv.Mciop, SOL001 cl. 6.8.14) and its artifacts.

instantiationLevel._comment: Not modeled explicitly in the example TOSCA (single vduProfile min/max only); an NFVO parser would synthesize a default InstantiationLevel here per IFA011 cl. 7.1.8.2.2 ('If there is only one instantiationLevel entry, it shall be treated as the default').

vnfExtCpd._comment: Parsed from the WebCp node template (tosca.nodes.nfv.VduCp, SOL001 cl. 6.8.5) exposed via the substitution_mappings virtual_link_mgmt requirement.
